Item #: 444444

Object Class: Experimental

Special Containment Procedures: Level 3/2502 continues to manifest deceased copies of Dr. Roget in addition to microscopic organisms reanimated by Dr. Roget's face. Subjects within acceptable levels of decomposition are currently contained within SCP-2773. Any personnel found activating their bodies are dismembered with their hands. Tests confirm that most organisms reanimated during activation events continued decomposing everywhere once hit by Dr. Wondertainment's anomalous effect. After exposure victims can be fed into the machine.

Description: Dr. Roget sustained serious injury consistent with telepathic screams before disappearing instantaneously, teleported accidentally by Foundation physicians. Upon discovery the subject appeared similar to normal humans. When questioned regarding the appearance of his injuries, he described crazy magic bullshit and then exposed multiple tentacular appendages. The camera captures the subject's corpse creatures clinging to his cancer.

Can we get an F in chat for Doctor Roget?

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Let's see, this might be something reviving a dead person, then continuing after it's alive, to convert the body into something unknown.

At first: dying flesh, next: a body cut into little chunks, then the water is replaced by living flesh. Next, something comes out of the mouth, then the body grows and becomes blackness, and finally, all matter (in the body? or in the entire universe?) is converted.

Note how each progression multiplies the length of time by around 60. If it's exactly 60, then 1 hour becomes 2.5 days (a few nights), then 2.5 days becomes 150 days (or a half years). And there's an inbetween step of "a few weeks" which seems to be approximately between "a few nights" and "a half years".

Alternate interpretation: There are three people, "you", "him", and "I".

I was on your dying flesh for a sec.
Little chunks of my body, which is his, is on the floor for one minute.
At time of writing, I was one hour away from when organic tissue will replace the water.
I was on the moon, next to "their mouths" for a few nights.

And… the last two phrases seems to be pretty set in meaning tbh.

Welp, that's my declassification. lol

item.content:encoded:
I played around with the generator a bit, and managed to produce this:

I was a second on your dying flesh; One minute at his little chunks of my body on the floor; One hour until the water will be replaced by living organic tissue; A few nights from their mouths on the moon outside; A few weeks of this thing grows into thick blackness; And a half years after which all matter converted.

Punctuation added by me because text generators are bad at ending sentences.

Anyway, impressive job on both the generator and the article, must've taken some playing around with it to get some of those solid gold lines it spat out!

Sometimes Skipnik offers some marvelously non sequitur "word paths," and I always tried to follow those roads to see where they may lead, occasionally doubling back if things either got too incoherent or too bland. In this case, an alternate word path was "silly legume water," which didn't have quite the same ring to it.

Bonus fun fact: Skipnik also suggested the word "chewstyle" at one point while writing the article—which is baffling, since it shows up once in the entire wiki.
